sunOnlyThrough._comment: Public levels through this number always use sun, including explicit requests.

rainLevel._comment: First public rain level and reliable light-rain fixture.

heavyRainLevel._comment: First public heavy-rain level and reliable fixture.

stormLevel._comment: First public storm level and reliable fixture.

earlySunCutoff._comment: Sun cutoff before rain unlocks; remaining seeds select wind.

rainCutoffs._comment: Cumulative sun/wind cutoffs after rain unlocks; remainder is rain.

heavyRainCutoffs._comment: Cumulative sun/wind/rain cutoffs after heavy rain unlocks.

stormCutoffs._comment: Cumulative sun/wind/rain/heavy-rain cutoffs after storms unlock.

rainIntensity._comment: rainIntensity for the fixed sun preset, normalized from zero to one.

windIntensity._comment: windIntensity for the fixed sun preset, normalized from zero to one.

severity._comment: severity for the fixed sun preset, normalized from zero to one.

cloudCoverage._comment: cloudCoverage for the fixed sun preset, normalized from zero to one.

daylight._comment: daylight for the fixed sun preset, normalized from zero to one.

rainIntensity._comment: rainIntensity for the fixed wind preset, normalized from zero to one.

windIntensity._comment: windIntensity for the fixed wind preset, normalized from zero to one.

severity._comment: severity for the fixed wind preset, normalized from zero to one.

cloudCoverage._comment: cloudCoverage for the fixed wind preset, normalized from zero to one.

daylight._comment: daylight for the fixed wind preset, normalized from zero to one.

rainIntensity._comment: rainIntensity for the fixed rain preset, normalized from zero to one.

windIntensity._comment: windIntensity for the fixed rain preset, normalized from zero to one.

severity._comment: severity for the fixed rain preset, normalized from zero to one.

cloudCoverage._comment: cloudCoverage for the fixed rain preset, normalized from zero to one.

daylight._comment: daylight for the fixed rain preset, normalized from zero to one.

rainIntensity._comment: rainIntensity for the fixed heavy-rain preset, normalized from zero to one.

windIntensity._comment: windIntensity for the fixed heavy-rain preset, normalized from zero to one.

severity._comment: severity for the fixed heavy-rain preset, normalized from zero to one.

cloudCoverage._comment: cloudCoverage for the fixed heavy-rain preset, normalized from zero to one.

daylight._comment: daylight for the fixed heavy-rain preset, normalized from zero to one.

rainIntensity._comment: rainIntensity for the fixed storm preset, normalized from zero to one.

windIntensity._comment: windIntensity for the fixed storm preset, normalized from zero to one.

severity._comment: severity for the fixed storm preset, normalized from zero to one.

cloudCoverage._comment: cloudCoverage for the fixed storm preset, normalized from zero to one.

daylight._comment: daylight for the fixed storm preset, normalized from zero to one.

windBase._comment: Base legacy wind amount before preset wind scaling.

windScale._comment: Multiplier converting preset wind intensity to legacy wind amount.

rainParticles._comment: Legacy particle budget advertised by a rainy weather state.

wetButterflies._comment: Legacy butterfly population advertised during rain; storms suppress it.

dryButterflies._comment: Legacy butterfly population advertised without rain.

birds._comment: Legacy bird population advertised outside storms.

squirrels._comment: Legacy squirrel population advertised outside storms.

startSeconds._comment: Earliest first lightning event in a storm.

thunderDelaySeconds._comment: Minimum paired thunder delay; seeded delay adds up to 0.8 seconds.

flashSeconds._comment: Duration of a storm lightning flash.
